name: Chest Expander Pull-Apart (Vertical)
instructions: Hold the chest expander overhead or at forehead height with arms mostly straight.
Pull the handles apart, moving your hands out and back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and keep your ribs down.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A chest-expander pull-apart performed overhead to train the rear delts, upper back and shoulder external rotators.
